name: OpenAI: GPT-6 Luna Pro
summary: This model is designed to handle a very large amount of information at once, with a 'context window' of 1,050,000 tokens, which means it can consider this much text or data when generating a response. It can also produce very long outputs, up to 128,000 tokens. The cost for using the model is 0.1 per 1 million tokens for the information you provide to it (input) and 0.5 per 1 million tokens for the information it generates (output).

strengths: The model can process an exceptionally large amount of input information at once.
The model is capable of generating very long responses.

name: OpenAI: GPT-6 Luna
summary: This model is designed to handle very large amounts of information, with a context window of 1,050,000 tokens, which means it can consider over a million pieces of words or characters at once. It can also generate very long responses, up to 128,000 output tokens. The pricing structure indicates that processing input is significantly cheaper than generating output.

strengths: Ability to process extremely large amounts of input information due to its 1,050,000 token context window.
Capable of generating very extensive responses, up to 128,000 tokens.
Cost-effective for tasks that involve processing a lot of input data but require relatively concise outputs, as input tokens are cheaper than output tokens.
weaknesses: Generating very long outputs can become more expensive due to the higher price per output token compared to input tokens.
